group 3 innate cells have a role in maintaining intestinal homeostasis during infection and that this function is dependent on the aryl hydrocaron receptor.
group 3 innate immune cells are critical to maintaining intestinal barrier function during infection and that their absence leads to a dysregulated immune response.
